external_structure.milp_timeout_probe: A 10-second MILP rerun on ten persistent failures produced zero fully feasible cases; default timeout was not the cause.
external_structure.seed_probe: Two-case four-draw matched probe: candidate feasible cases 2/2 (seed19), 1/2 (seed20), 2/2 (seed21); controls 1/2, 0/2, 1/2. Direction is positive but APTE is unstable and HPWL signs are mixed.
external_structure.seed_probe_pooled: candidate feasibility 5/6 versus control 2/6; exact McNemar p=0.25; only two n10 cases are double-feasible and their mean HPWL is -3.43%.
external_structure.failure_modes: With fallback, HARD candidate/control both 79/176 fully feasible; remaining failures are outline-only misses with shapes kept. SOFT candidate/control is 55/176 versus 40/176. Candidate-vs-control advantage is SOFT-concentrated, while fallback itself helps both arms versus no fallback.
external_structure.fallback_effect: Candidate 10/22 with fallback versus 2/22 without (9 gains, 1 loss, McNemar p=0.0215); control 9/22 versus 1/22 (8 gains, 0 losses, p=0.0078). HPWL has only one paired-feasible case and is not a performance result.
external_structure.fallback_effect_16draw: Candidate 13/22 with fallback versus 2/22 without (11 gains, 0 losses, p=0.00098); control 9/22 versus 1/22 (8 gains, 0 losses, p=0.0078). HARD rises from 0/11 to 6/11 for both arms. HPWL still has only 2 candidate and 1 control paired-feasible cases.
external_structure.fallback_effect_seed20_21: seed20 candidate 0→1 and control 0→0; seed21 candidate 0→2 and control 0→1, with no losses on the two-case cohorts.
external_structure.next_gate: Do not promote HPWL. The 16-draw feasibility coverage signal remains exploratory; any performance claim requires an untouched structural cohort.
external_structure.claim_boundary: Feasibility coverage improvement is not a performance win.

claim_boundary: A one-step smoke or positive subset screen is not a CVPR result. Bookshelf HPWL is never ranked without an outline-feasible legalized layout.
